sampling: One greedy response per case; no repair or retries
semanticReview: Explicit per-criterion human/agent review bound to exact output hashes; missing review fails closed.
independence: Corrected inputs after v1 diagnostic exposure; reusable development acceptance, not a fresh independent benchmark.
androidGate: Separate saved-capture checks, immediate deterministic summary, latency/memory/thermal/cancellation checks required before operational use.
correction: V1 omitted explicit frame types and radio domains in some inputs; preserve its run but do not use it as a readiness score.
